user_id.description: Reference to the visitor or buyer record associated with this inquiry.

name.description: Name of the buyer submitting the sourcing inquiry.

company.description: Company name provided by the buyer.

destination_country.description: Destination market or country for the shipment.

product_category.description: Product, category, or item the buyer wants to source.

message.description: Detailed sourcing requirements, including specs, quantity, timeline, QC needs, or shipping requirements.

status.description: Internal follow-up status for the sourcing inquiry.

source_page.description: Page path where the inquiry was submitted.

submitted_at.description: Timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.
